work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Issue #93 remains active through the frozen collection cutoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind admission from the pinned realbench comparable English-prompt publication snapshot. W1 preserves the direct DeepSeek V4 Pro OpenCode and Pi observations as a candidate comparison group and preserves the Claude Code proxy arm separately because the source documents a different serving route plus DeepSeek V4 Flash sub-agent traffic.
discovery_pass.benchmark_surface: 27 software-engineering tasks x five comparable English-prompt runs per harness; deterministic task-local verification
discovery_pass.environment: Apple M2 Max; 12 CPU cores; 32 GB RAM; macOS 26.2 (25C56); local APFS SSD
discovery_pass.curation: Committed curator selects the first five valid English-prompt records per public agent/task cell after the source-defined prompt-language boundary; runner-infrastructure records that never reached agent/verify exit codes are excluded; agent timeouts remain strict failures.

source_known_dimensions: five selected comparable English-prompt runs per task
same direct DeepSeek V4 Pro provider/model label
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: Pi explicitly pins thinking=high while the OpenCode wrapper does not pin an equivalent reasoning-effort setting
exact historical OpenCode and Pi CLI versions are unresolved
exact service-side DeepSeek V4 Pro revision is unresolved
the snapshot invocation timeout is unresolved even though runner default is 600 seconds
the publication snapshot is a deterministic curated slice of a larger exploratory run log

source_known_dimensions: same deterministic verifier and published machine
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: Claude Code uses the DeepSeek Anthropic-compatible proxy rather than the direct provider path
source native telemetry reports DeepSeek V4 Flash sub-agent calls in addition to the primary V4 Pro surface

candidate_comparison_groups.w1_boundary_note: Preserved as related evidence but not merged into the direct-provider candidate group.

protocol_deviations_and_failures.detail: The temporary exact-head workflow rendered 299 observations, materialized the generated registry commit, passed repository validators, the pass-47 realbench admission check, and the existing live admission path.

GitHub did not automatically execute the workflow for the bot-authored generated-registry commit; this was superseded by explicit restoration of the standard workflow and a fresh read-only validation.
